purpose: Portable piece-scoped projection of the actually passed final normal saved-build verification. No new cold-meshing run, human approval, installation, or game observation is claimed.

provenance.build_method: The normal builder emitted the current source selection, reused matching verified model caches where available, and completed native input, resource, PATH, model, construction, menu, shadow, archive, and packaging checks. This report projects those executed results without rerunning meshing.

paths.curve_quality_scope: Exact approved module samples retained; assembled routes have independent curve-quality audits.

models.full_width_bed_validation_scope: Every local mesh and train path matches the current reusable-module baseline; complete assembled corridor coverage is checked separately.

shadows.projection: vertical; X/Z [-8,8] metres; +X right; +Z down; no height offset

intrinsic_graph_source_validation: Actual saved PATH resources were independently re-extracted. All permitted journeys, forbidden pairs, and interface fingerprints match the current record. Reachability traversal order is normalized to the existing record only after proving set equality, preserving its dependency fingerprint.
geometry_scope: This reusable type alone. Intrinsic routes, models, and construction checks do not establish arbitrary neighbour compatibility or observed game operation. A complete assembly has separate saved-resource and game checks.
